label: Tactile button
desc: A physical-feeling button with a shaped face on a firm edge that presses down on pointer or Space/Enter and springs back.
use: Primary and secondary calls to action on landing pages, sign-in and checkout.

label: Scramble text
desc: Text whose changed characters scramble through random glyphs and settle left to right; screen readers get the real text.
use: Hero taglines, rotating status lines, dashboard headings that change.

label: Receipt printer
desc: A checkout success state where a slot prints a paper receipt line by line, ending in a torn edge.
use: Order or payment confirmation, invoice paid, booking complete.

label: Cassette player
desc: A compact cassette with turning reels, play/pause, a seek bar and title/artist; visual only, no audio.
use: Podcast or music teasers on landing pages, a playful media card on a dashboard.

label: Hold to confirm
desc: A button that fills while held (pointer or Space/Enter), confirms at 100%, then offers a timed Undo before finalising.
use: Destructive or irreversible actions: delete a project, revoke a key, unpublish a page.

label: Magnetic drop zone
desc: A file drop target that leans toward an incoming drag, lists the dropped file names, and falls back to a browse input.
use: Upload areas on a dashboard, connect page or publishing list (no upload is performed by the component).

label: Dynamic button
desc: A button whose width animates as its label moves through states (Save, Saving…, Saved) with an inline icon swap.
use: Save and submit buttons in settings forms, sign-in and publishing flows.

label: Playing cards
desc: A composable playing card (rank, suit, face-down) and a fanned hand you thumb through with hover or arrow keys and play with a click.
use: Playful feature cards, game or loyalty-card landing sections, card-style selection.
